summary: Extensions should generate small task frames from stable entry points, continuously test commands, and surface instruction conflicts as normal engineering findings.

items.text: Build a task-specific active frame from the nearest entry point and retrieve referenced details only when the current step needs them.
Turn documented bootstrap, test, lint, and build commands into executable documentation checks so stale entry points fail visibly.
Add an instruction linter that detects duplication, unreachable links, unbounded wording, conflicting scopes, missing owners, and rules that should be enforced outside prompts.
Regenerate or queue review of affected entry points when workflow, dependency, ownership, or architecture artifacts change.
